title: Database Administrator
description: A roadmap for operating reliable databases: SQL, backups, performance, security, replication, and production monitoring.

tree.name: Database Fundamentals
tree.description: Understand relational models, SQL, transactions, indexing, normalization, and database server responsibilities.

children.name: SQL and Querying
children.description: Write joins, CTEs, window functions, transactions, constraints, views, and stored procedures.

children.name: Schema Design
children.description: Design tables, keys, relationships, indexes, constraints, and migrations for maintainable systems.

tree.name: Operations and Reliability
tree.description: Keep databases available through backups, restores, replication, upgrades, monitoring, and capacity planning.

resources.title: How to Become a Database Administrator (Intellipaat)

children.name: Backup and Restore
children.description: Create backup policies, test restores, plan retention, and define RPO/RTO expectations.

children.name: Replication and High Availability
children.description: Understand read replicas, failover, streaming replication, lag, and disaster recovery tradeoffs.

children.name: Practice: Restore and Tune Drill
children.description: Restore a backup, find slow queries, add indexes carefully, and document before/after performance.

tree.name: Performance and Security
tree.description: Tune queries, protect sensitive data, control access, audit changes, and document operational runbooks.

children.name: Query Tuning
children.description: Use EXPLAIN, indexes, statistics, query plans, slow query logs, and workload-aware tuning.

children.name: Database Security
children.description: Manage roles, grants, encryption, auditing, secrets, least privilege, and compliance basics.

children.name: Project: Database Operations Lab
children.description: Provision PostgreSQL, design a schema, load sample data, configure backups, test restore, tune slow queries, and document a DBA runbook.

tree.name: Cloud Databases and Incident Response
tree.description: Operate managed databases, automate maintenance, and respond calmly when production data systems misbehave.

children.name: Managed Database Services
children.description: Compare RDS, Cloud SQL, Azure SQL, read replicas, parameter groups, maintenance windows, and snapshots.

children.name: Incident Runbooks
children.description: Write runbooks for slow queries, replication lag, storage exhaustion, failed backups, and emergency restores.
